scope: Two original records, one supplied source; no new literature search.

userChoice.choice: Show k tradeoff with a constant-k reference

primaryEvidence.publicationEvidence: Author arXiv record Comments explicitly states FOCS 2026.

checks.finding: O(nk) randomized average total runtime through k≤n^(1/37). Graph input is adjacency-matrix format; a pair query takes constant time.
Deterministic average Õ(nk) runtime in the same range. The tilde hides polylog(n); no specific log exponent is inferred.
U is uniform over labeled k-colorable graphs on vertex set [n], counting distinct labelings separately.

On any promised graph and random string, a successful internal loop yields a proper coloring. If all loops fail, exhaustive search yields a full proper coloring. Average runtime combines input randomness and algorithm coins; no external FAIL and no worst-case fast runtime promise.

For k≤n^(1/3), zero-error algorithms require Ω(nk) matrix queries and hence time on every input and random string. This implies average lower bounds under U and algorithm coins. No bounded-error statement is inferred.

corrections.before: Exact k-coloring could be read as exactly k nonempty colors, and axes used q/Δ.
corrections.after: Proper coloring with colors from [k]; unused colors permitted. k is known colorability promise, not maximum degree. k=1 excluded because its promised graph is edgeless and needs no pair queries.

corrections.before: Combined randomized/deterministic runtime statement was unplotted.
corrections.after: Two separately inspectable variants preserve one original upper ID. Pair-query upper bounds are explicit deductions from unit-cost total runtime. The total-time view displays the theorems directly.

corrections.before: Average-time lower wording, with no precise correctness or larger-range figure.
corrections.after: Zero-error on every promised G and random string r. Direct matrix-query proof supplies the lower as well as time. Validity reaches n^(1/3); algorithms only reach n^(1/37).

nonClaims: No upper runtime or query bound is asserted beyond n^(1/37).
No worst-case fast upper runtime is inferred from the average.
No chosen polylogarithmic exponent, numerical spacing of k, or numerical cost multiplier.
No lower bound for arbitrary bounded-error algorithms.
Appendix A LCA probe-count/access-unit ambiguity is outside this full-output figure; no LCA cost imported.

representation.y: Average cost divided by nk; tiers 1 and polylog n. Vertical separation describes bound orders, not exact constants or a proved deterministic gap.
representation.comparison: Randomized Θ(nk) within the common range. Deterministic Ω(nk) to Õ(nk). The lower-only extension stays visible.
representation.constantK: Randomized Θ(n); deterministic Õ(n) upper with Ω(n) lower.
representation.theme: All shared colors use CSS theme variables; private deterministic setup color uses light-dark.
